answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Each identity must lock 500 USD in escrow and solve a Yarrow-generated challenge before it can vote or grade. A farm of 1,000 clones pays 1,000 × 500 USD = 500,000 USD and forfeits all of it when the audit flags the clone pattern; retrying across a comet’s orbital period or during a gale-induced network partition does not stop the slash. Honesty stays cheaper.
